verdict.rationale: Gumroad hosts each product on its own canonical short URL and creator storefront, so a developer can send buyers to a vendor-hosted page and accept payment without building a payment UI. Community comments praise its simplicity for buyers. However, the evidence never explicitly describes a dedicated checkout or redirect flow, and nothing documents conversion optimization. Missing for 10: explicit hosted-checkout/redirect documentation, evidence of conversion-optimized checkout features, independent hands-on checkout corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Each creator has a storefront on their own subdomain, and every product has a canonical short URL.
I upload a file, set a price, and I can start selling on the internet.
Create and customize your storefront with our all-in-one platform or choose to use your personal site instead.
